title: Childcare centers and education studios: business-contact fallback with owner-role separation
hypothesis: The current fallback can discover an independent childcare center or education studio and a published business contact, but no implemented center register or directory role establishes ownership or an owner-confirmed mobile. Director, administrator, company, and owner evidence must remain distinct.
ownerSource: No center owner source is implemented. A PA/NY/TX center directory may name a company or director/administrator, but those are business or role candidates only. Independent explicit public ownership evidence for the same company is required before an owner label.
phoneSource: The current effective path is recipe-A discovery after the recipe-B center route finds no register mapping. Its published listing number is a business-contact candidate only, never proof of a director's or owner's handset, line type, reachability, or consent.

workflow.label: Center or studio discovery
workflow.detail: Start with the effective recipe-A fallback for a child-care center, preschool, tutoring, dance, music, or swim-school business.

workflow.label: Commercial center or studio fit
workflow.detail: Require evidence for the requested center or education-studio cohort; home-provider records do not enter this workflow.

workflow.label: Hold home or off-cohort record
workflow.detail: Reject or hold home-directory, residential, generic education, or otherwise unsupported records.

workflow.label: Independent-business check
workflow.detail: Apply the existing education_childcare franchise exclusion before phone verification.

workflow.label: Hold franchise candidate
workflow.detail: A brand match does not prove a local owner; keep it out of the independent-center path.

workflow.label: Published business contact
workflow.detail: Retain only a published business number for the matched business; it is not an owner or direct-mobile claim.

workflow.label: Hold no contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer a phone from a company, center license, director, or administrator record.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require line-type, live, DNC, suppression, time-zone, and duplicate checks before any delivery decision.

workflow.label: Ownership evidence decision
workflow.detail: A center company is not a person; a director or administrator is a role candidate. Require independent explicit ownership evidence for the same matched company.

workflow.label: Hold business-only or role-only contact
workflow.detail: Keep a contact as business-only when ownership is absent, ambiguous, or belongs only to a director or administrator role.

workflow.label: Deliver supported contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only after contact/compliance gates and independent owner evidence pass; owner-mobile status requires separate handset evidence.

failures.risk: The configured recipe-B center route has PA/NY/TX name_source descriptions but no register_source mapping or implemented center adapter segment.
failures.mitigation: Keep the effective Maps fallback and mark the center-register path unavailable until a dedicated center-only adapter and mapping exist.

failures.risk: A director, administrator, provider, company, and owner are represented as the same identity.
failures.mitigation: Preserve the stated role and company separately; require independent explicit ownership evidence matched to the company before an owner label.

failures.risk: Home-directory rows contaminate a center cohort or expose residential location data.
failures.mitigation: Do not reuse PA/NY/TX home adapters: their seven configured segments are home-only. A future center adapter must exclude home rows and residential fields.

failures.risk: A known childcare or education franchise is treated as an independent center or studio.
failures.mitigation: Apply the existing education_childcare brand group before paid verification.

failures.risk: A published business number is labelled a director's, owner's, or owner-confirmed mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep business-contact, handset, line-type, reachability, compliance, and ownership evidence as separate required gates.

iterations.hypothesis: The five live-brain aliases for centers and education studios have a configured center-register route in their named states.
iterations.test: Five-case local route/code audit on 2026-09-24 using child care center/PA, preschool/NY, dance studio/TX, music school/PA, and tutoring/NY through route, registerSourceFor, and quoteJob. Command used node --experimental-strip-types; no network, credential, provider, contact-data, or paid call ran.
iterations.observed: All 5/5 resolve to childcare_center and its configured recipe B, but registerSourceFor returned null for every case. quoteJob safely selected recipe A with a No register for childcare center path note. This is routing behavior only, not a source, phone, owner, or delivery result.
iterations.change: Record the effective Maps fallback and block the advertised center-register/owner path until a real center-only adapter and register_source mapping are implemented.

iterations.hypothesis: Existing childcare adapters include center segments suitable for the childcare_center path.
iterations.test: Local adapter-request code audit on 2026-09-24 of paChildcare, nyChildcare, and txChildcare request cursors; no response body or network was read.
iterations.observed: Three adapters exposed seven requested segments. All seven were home-only and none requested PA Child Care Center, NY DCC/SACC, or TX Licensed Center.
iterations.change: Do not route centers through home adapters or use their address-bearing payloads. A later dedicated center adapter must preserve director/company roles without owner promotion.

measurement.result: Five local route cases all resolved to childcare_center with no register_source and safely quoted recipe-A fallback. A separate no-network adapter audit found seven PA/NY/TX childcare request segments, all home-only. No names, phone values, addresses, owner evidence, mobile status, reachability, DNC outcome, or delivery was measured.

cost.basis: Local fixture/code audit only; no paid discovery, append, verification, or provider request was invoked.
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. Historical brain estimates use a different, unverified denominator and are not a cost per clean center-owner contact.

implementation.summary: The job quote safely falls back to recipe A for the five reviewed center/studio aliases because childcare_center has no register_source. The brain still describes recipe B and PA/NY/TX directory strings, while all implemented childcare adapters are home-only. Franchise exclusion is wired for childcare_center; no center owner-source or role-preserving center adapter is implemented.

nextMeasurement: After a dedicated, eligible center-only adapter and ownership-evidence path exist, run a free aggregate-only 5-20 row audit with separate denominators for center rows, company records, director/admin roles, independently owner-confirmed company matches, published business contacts, contact-gate passes, and deliveries. Exclude home rows and residential fields.
